detail: `ios_test.sh --ui <bareMethod>`(裸方法名)對**不在** class `BooksAndVocabUITests` 的 UITest method 靜默零執行(bare method 只在預設 suite 內解析,別的 UITest class 如 `ExploreNavigationUITests` 命中不了)。**2026-08-05 更正:原記的「回 tests=0 卻 exit 0 = FALSE GREEN」已不成立**——`ops/ios_test.sh:1904-1913` 的 false-green guard(`TEST SUCCEEDED` 且 `count_executed_tests`==0 → 印 `✗ FALSE GREEN` 並 exit 1)由 `4930a1e37`(2026-06-03)引入,**早於本條目建檔的 2026-07-10 整整一個月**,故條目自始即誤述現況。實測(`--list` dry-run):bare `testExploreTabShowsSections` → `-only-testing:BooksAndVocabUITests/BooksAndVocabUITests/…`(錯 class),限定 `ExploreNavigationUITests/testExploreTabShowsSections` → 正確;成因在 `:527-534`,非 `Class/method` 形式即硬拼 `$TEST_TARGET/$TEST_TARGET/$t`。現況實為**人體工學**:白跑一整輪 build+test 才在尾端紅,且訊息只說 stale/bogus `-only-testing`、不指向 bare-method 規則。workaround=用完整限定 `Class/method`。fix 候選:runner auto-resolve method→其所屬 class,或 `--help`/零匹配錯誤明示「bare method 僅限預設 suite,跨 class 用 Class/method」
plan:
CONFIRMED, and worse than the entry says. ops/ios_test.sh:528-535 builds the -only-testing flag for a bare method name by string concatenation with ZERO existence check: line 533 emits -only-testing:$TEST_TARGET/$TEST_TARGET/$t. Measured today with --list: a method name that exists nowhere in the tree (testExploreTabShowsSections) still produces a flag and exits 0. Two live callers are broken by this right now, not merely slowed down:
  (a) ops/app_review_evidence.py:381 passes the bare name testLiveDemoAccountHasProEntitlement to ios_test.sh --live-demo. That method lives in "final class LiveDemoAccessUITests" (ios/BooksAndVocabUITests/LiveDemoAccessUITests.swift:79,81), so the run resolves to BooksAndVocabUITests/BooksAndVocabUITests/... -> 0 tests match -> the App Review live-demo evidence run can only ever end at the false-green guard (ios_test.sh:1904-1914). Verified by --list with the full live-demo argv.
  (b) The documented example method testLaunchShowsPrimaryTabs does not exist at all. The real one is testLaunchShowsAllTabs (ios/BooksAndVocabUITests/BooksAndVocabUITests.swift:15).

STEP 1 -- ops/ios_test.sh, replace the else arm at :532-534 so a bare name is resolved to its OWN container via the discovery lib already sourced at :234. Exact replacement for the whole :528-535 block (prototyped end-to-end against the real test tree today; bash 3.2 safe):
  elif [[ ${#SPECIFIC_TESTS[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    for t in "${SPECIFIC_TESTS[@]}"; do
      if [[ "$t" == */* ]]; then
        ONLY_FLAGS+=("-only-testing:$TEST_TARGET/$t")
        continue
      fi
      resolved=()
      while IFS= read -r flag; do
        [[ -n "$flag" ]] && resolved+=("$flag")
      done < <(discover_only_flags "$TEST_DIR" "^${t}$" "$TEST_TARGET")
      if [[ ${#resolved[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
        echo "[ios_test] error: no test method named $t under $TEST_DIR ($TEST_TARGET)" >&2
        echo "[ios_test] 裸方法名會掃描 $TEST_DIR 反查所屬 class / @Suite 容器;別的 target 請加 --ui,或直接給 Class/method。" >&2
        exit 2
      fi
      [[ ${#resolved[@]} -gt 1 ]] && echo "[ios_test] note: $t 命中 ${#resolved[@]} 個容器,全部納入" >&2
      ONLY_FLAGS+=("${resolved[@]}")
    done
Leave the Class/method arm (:530-531) exactly as it is -- an explicitly qualified id must stay a pass-through, otherwise a caller can no longer target something the awk discovery does not see. exit 2 matches the usage-error convention already used at :160-192. The anchored pattern ^name$ is safe: discover_only_flags matches func name OR container name case-insensitively, and an anchored method name cannot collide with a container name. TEST_DIR / TEST_TARGET are resolved at :384-406 and --all-targets is already rejected together with specific tests at :412-415, so this arm only ever runs for unit or ui scope.

STEP 2 -- fix the phantom method name in the same PR, or STEP 1 turns the documented examples into exit 2: ops/ios_test.sh:13 and :15, plus docs/sop/ios.md:170, :172, :256 -- replace testLaunchShowsPrimaryTabs with testLaunchShowsAllTabs. While in the ios_test.sh header, add one usage line stating that a bare method name is resolved to its enclosing class/@Suite by scanning the scope test dir, and that Class/method still works.

STEP 3 -- expect the Swift Testing identifiers to change shape, and do not "fix" that back. Today a bare Swift Testing unit test yields a paren-less id (measured: resolveNotebookId_emptyCandidate_returnsDefault -> .../resolveNotebookId_emptyCandidate_returnsDefault); through discovery it yields the signature form ...returnsDefault(), which is what xcodebuild actually matches (see the emit() comment in ops/lib/ios_test_discovery.sh about arity and 0-match false greens).

STEP 4 -- regression cases in ops/test_ios_test_discovery.sh (that file is the routed test for ops/ios_test.sh per worktree_orchestrate.py:242; add them next to the existing --list E2E sections at :265-330, following the local idiom of self-discovering a real method name rather than hardcoding one): (i) a bare UI method whose container is NOT BooksAndVocabUITests must resolve to its own class; (ii) an unknown bare name must exit 2 and the stderr must mention Class/method; (iii) an explicit Class/method must still pass through unchanged. Extra non -only-testing lines on stdout are safe -- every existing --list assertion filters on the only-testing substring.

MUST STAY GREEN: ./ops/test_ios_test_discovery.sh in full, and ./ops/ios_test.sh --list -g <pattern> / --file <Type> (untouched arms).
